Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Contents 1 Game Overview 2 Player Turn 2.1 Optional actions 2.2 Mandatory action 3 Card abilities 4 Crowns 5 Turn end 6 Game end 7 Reminders Game Overview The players take turns, one after another, until the end of the game is triggered. On your turn, you take tokens from the board or use those in your possession to buy Jewel cards, which award you with the Prestige points and Crowns you require to win. These cards also offer special abilities and bonuses, which reduce the cost of acquiring future Jewel cards. To win, you must fulfil one of the three conditions indicated on the Victory tile. Player Turn On your turn, you first perform none, one, or both of the optional actions, in the indicated order (i.e. you cannot spend 1 Privilege Scroll after a Replenish action). Then, you must perform one mandatory action. Optional actions Perform any, all or none in the indicated order 1) Spend 1 (Privilege Scroll) to take 1 non-Gold token from the board. Can be done any number of times. 2) Replenish as many empty token spaces as there are tokens in the bag. Opponent takes 1 (Privilege Scroll). Cannot be done if there are no tokens in the bag. Tokens will be replenished starting from the central space and following the printed spiral until there are no more tokens in the bag. Mandatory action You must perform one of the following three actions: 1) Take up to 3 adjacent non-Gold tokens in an uninterrupted row, column, or diagonal. • 3 identical or 2 Pearl tokens: opponent takes 1 (Privilege Scroll). 2) Take 1 Gold token from the board + reserve 1 Jewel card (either from the pyramid or the top of any deck). • Cannot be done if there are no Gold tokens on the board or if you have 3 reserved cards. 3) Purchase 1 Jewel card from the pyramid or your reserve. Cost (bottom left). • Bonus Jewel (top right) decreases the cost of future card purchases. • If there is a white number in the top left, these are Prestige points. Gain 20 of these to win the game. Card abilities ​ Take another turn. ​ Take 1 (Privilege Scroll). ​ Take a token matching the color of this card from the board. ​ Take 1 non-Gold token from your opponent. ​ Copy the color of a previously acquired bonus jewel. Crowns • Upon acquiring your 3rd Crown, take 1 of the available Royal cards and resolve its ability. • Upon acquiring your 6th Crown, take 1 of the available Royal cards and resolve its ability. A royal card earns you additional prestige points and grants an above card ability. Taking a Royal card is not an action. Turn end Discard down to 10 tokens. Game end A player wins immediately with: • ≥ 20 Prestige points OR • ≥ 10 Crowns OR • ≥ 10 Prestige points on cards of the same color (including "copy color" cards). [Rating: 1/10] Terrible hoarding mechanics, even with the house rule anti-play on BGA, I still suffer a game with 12 turns straight just take coins and discard coins. Terrible game. Worst experience.

[Rating: 2/10] Okish game, a bit too slow,and they kinda made it worst than splendor with this pearl adding.

[Rating: 2/10] My wife liked this game, and I really loved the art. However, I felt it extremely boring. It is an extremely simple engine building game with almost no strategy.

[Rating: 2/10] Why would anyone want to play this drawn out variation of Splendor. I've heard many praise it but no thanks. Nothing like the actual game and nothing like 7 Wonders Duel making 7 Wonders a great game.
